cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
cp classic_panel.py backup_runsfix_panel.py; cp classic_pos_html.py backup_runsfix_pos_html.py
for f in classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py; do
  curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
  python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())" || { echo PARSE_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
done
cp /tmp/new_classic_panel.py classic_panel.py; cp /tmp/new_classic_pos_html.py classic_pos_html.py; chown tbot:tbot classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 8; systemctl is-active classicbot
curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);r=d['runs'][0];print(len(d['runs']),r['start_ms'],r['cfg'].get('be_trigger'),r['cfg'].get('be_lock'))"
curl -s localhost:8091/ | grep -c "data-k=emp"
